name: reduced-motion-performance
description: Validate reduced-motion behavior, loaded audio, and stable runtime scene cost after repeated destruction.

args.code: local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke("SetSettings",{motion=false,sound=true,uiScale=1,persist=false}) local result=a:Invoke("__RunCamera",3) a:Invoke("SetSettings",{motion=true,sound=true,uiScale=1,persist=false}) result.reducedValid=result.actions==3 and result.initialOrbitSettled==true and result.settleTimedOut~=true and (result.maxStep or math.huge)<=.05 and (result.zoomDelta or math.huge)<.08 and (result.angle or math.huge)<.25 and (result.visibleRatio or 0)>=.9 and result.inside==0 and (result.maxBack or math.huge)<.5 and result.type=="Custom" and result.handoffActive~=true and (result.lead or math.huge)<.2 return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: reduced camera is judged by suppressed-motion invariants without an unconditional lead requirement

args.code:
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local command=game.ServerStorage:WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation")
command:Invoke("Reset")
command:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=500,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0})
local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG
local function sample()
 local result={parts=0,sounds=0,loaded=0,particles=0,debris=#root["Depth Physics Debris"]:GetChildren()}
 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then result.parts+=1 elseif d:IsA("Sound") then result.sounds+=1 if d.IsLoaded then result.loaded+=1 end elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then result.particles+=1 end end
 return result
end
local before=sample()
command:Invoke("BreakWallCycles","Brick Wall",20)
task.wait(5)
local after=sample()
local stable=after.parts==before.parts and after.sounds==before.sounds and after.particles==before.particles and after.debris==0
local loadedAll=before.sounds>0 and before.loaded==before.sounds and after.loaded==after.sounds
return HttpService:JSONEncode({stable=stable,loadedAll=loadedAll,before=before,after=after})

steps.label: scene composition returns to its own deterministic baseline after repeated destruction
